name: Aged map paper with asymmetric worn corners

opacity.source: exact alpha channel of the RGBA color texture

alpha_policy: Use RGBA map coverage once. The separate opacity image is optional for pipelines that need an independent mask. Avoid multiplying it into the same RGBA alpha twice.
normal_map: Keep the existing paper normal map and its current convention, strength, and UV transform.

uv_mapping.origin: usual material UV; image rows are top-to-bottom
uv_mapping.fold_note: Keep the material UV coordinates fixed while the 5 accordion panels move. Each panel samples its original fifth of the full unfolded sheet.

material_color: #ffffff: avoid applying the previous yellow tint over the new colored texture
cutout_scope: Apply the same sheet mask to the paper-bound ink, ornaments, border and printed names, and to matching custom depth or shadow materials.
geometry_note: Corner losses are alpha cutouts. Retain the existing modeled curled corner. Additional lifting, thickness and realistic fold motion require geometry; not supplied by opacity.
content: Blank paper only: mottling, foxing, water tidemarks, fibers, asymmetric wear and corner nicks; no ink or typography.
resolution_note: Native generated resolution; no upscaling was applied.
